entries.name: Human Lovers Club
entries.content: The Human Lovers club, on paper, is known as the Eeveelution club. It's a club of nine different Eeveelutions, all with the goal of seducing and breeding with one certain human boy. Their leader is an Eevee, with the other members being an Umbreon, a Sylveon, a Leafeon, a Vaporeon, an Espeon, a Glaceon, a Jolteon, and a Flareon.
